context: One day of a visitor in a superhero city: a sunny downtown plaza in the morning, a rooftop training terrace at noon, the rescue workshop in the afternoon, and a golden-hour hero hall by the skyline.
place: downtown plaza with clean pavement and small snack carts; rooftop training terrace with safety rails and rubber tiles; rescue workshop with metal worktables; hero hall with polished stone floor and an open terrace overlooking a bright skyline
concept: A cheerful tourist day through the safest, most iconic places of a superhero world, from public city sights to rooftop gadgets and hero-hall souvenirs.
palette: Bright comic-book colours with clean turquoise, yellow, purple, green, peach, blue, orange, pink, mint and red backgrounds, always sunny and friendly.
